aka: 扶田資本股份有限公司

strategy.thesis: Taiwan's first food-and-restaurant-tech VC fund and accelerator, founded by serial restaurant-tech entrepreneurs and food-industry experts. Invests across the AgriFood Tech value chain 'from farmland to dining table' — agritech, alternative protein, supply chain/logistics, sustainable packaging, cloud kitchens, restaurant automation/robotics, smart retail, aquaculture — backing teams with clear international scaling ambitions.

application.how_to_apply: Apply via website for the accelerator cohort; also makes direct VC investments.

summary.en: Taiwan's first food-and-restaurant-tech VC fund plus accelerator (founded 2020), investing across the AgriFood Tech value chain from agritech and alternative protein to cloud kitchens, restaurant automation and aquaculture, with portfolio reach across Asia-Pacific and North America.
summary.local: 台灣第一個餐飲科技創投基金與創業加速器（2020 年成立），投資範圍橫跨食農科技價值鏈，從農業科技、替代蛋白到雲端廚房、餐飲自動化與水產養殖，版圖跨及亞太與北美。

name.local: 財團法人好食好事基金會 / 好食好事加速器

strategy.thesis: Taiwan's first and largest agri-food tech startup accelerator, established by the Dingxin Hede Fund (頂新和德基金) as a non-profit foundation. Nurtures food-and-agriculture startups across agricultural/food supply-chain technology, food biotech, functional foods, packaging/materials, alternative proteins and sustainability, and will selectively invest directly in standout teams.

investment.raw: selective direct investment; e.g. NT$100M Pre-A into ECOCO (2024)

application.how_to_apply: Apply online (rolling admissions, deadline ~March 31); two-stage evaluation (document review then site visit). No application fee.

summary.en: Taiwan's first and largest agri-food tech accelerator, a non-profit foundation established in June 2017 by the Dingxin Hede Fund. Runs a ~4-month free accelerator; has supported 78+ startups whose alumni have raised over NT$1.27B, and selectively invests directly (e.g. NT$100M Pre-A into ECOCO in 2024).
summary.local: 台灣第一個也是最大的食農科技加速器，由「頂新和德基金」於 2017 年 6 月捐助成立的非營利財團法人。提供約 4 個月免費加速器課程，已輔導 78 家以上新創、校友累計募資逾新台幣 12.7 億元，並會選擇性直接投資（例如 2024 年對 ECOCO 投資新台幣 1 億元 Pre-A）。

name.en: MOA Agricultural Technology Venture Investment Plan
name.local: 農業科技創業投資計畫

aka: 農業科技創業投資計畫作業要點
農發基金農業科技創投

aum.raw: NT$10 billion plan scale (規模100億元)

check_size.raw: up to NT$100M per company; ≤NT$30M per disbursement

strategy.thesis: A government agricultural-development-fund investment program run by Taiwan's Ministry of Agriculture (formerly Council of Agriculture). Capital is entrusted to trustee financial institutions which set up a VC review panel and co-invest equity in young agricultural-science R&D companies — covering new varieties, technologies, products and technical services across agriculture, forestry, fisheries and animal husbandry.

application.how_to_apply: Eligible agri-science R&D companies (incorporated <5 years, paid-in capital ≥NT$50M, or ≥NT$30M if in a designated biotech park) apply to the trustee institution's VC review panel.

summary.en: A Taiwan Ministry of Agriculture investment program (established 2007) with an NT$10B planned scale that channels government agricultural-development-fund capital via trustee financial institutions to take minority equity (government share ≤49%, up to NT$100M per company) in young agri-science R&D companies across crops, forestry, fisheries and livestock.
summary.local: 農業部（前農委會）於 2007 年訂定的政府投資計畫，規模新台幣 100 億元，透過受託金融機構（設創投審議小組）以官股合計不超過 49%、單一公司上限新台幣 1 億元，投資成立未滿 5 年的農業科技研發公司，涵蓋農林漁牧的新品種、新技術與新產品。

sources.title: 行政院農業委員會農業科技創業投資計畫作業要點簡介
sources.supports: NT$10B scale; government equity ≤49%; up to NT$100M per company; ≤NT$30M per disbursement; eligibility <5yrs and NT$50M (NT$30M in biotech park); established Oct 12 2007
sources.quote: 規模100億元 ... 官股合計不得超過百分之49 ... 單一公司被投資金額以新台幣1億元為上限 ... 每次以新台幣3千萬元為上限

verification_notes: Plan operating points first issued 12 Oct 2007 (ROC year 96). Current cumulative number of invested companies not published in the fetched source (null). 'Stages' inferred from young-company eligibility; the program follows behind private VCs as a co-investor.

name.en: Agricultural Technology Research Institute — Industry Development Center

strategy.thesis: A Ministry-of-Agriculture-affiliated foundation (established 2014) building a platform for the industrialization and commercialization of agricultural technology. Its Industry Development Center incubates and guides agri-tech firms and farmer organizations through tech diffusion, incubation/advisory and industry value-add divisions — primarily a non-equity service provider rather than a direct equity investor.

perks: cross-institute collaboration with MOA research stations
program.eligibility: Agricultural technology firms and farmer/tech teams

application.how_to_apply: Apply for resident incubation / advisory via ATRI Industry Development Center.

summary.en: ATRI (農科院), a Ministry of Agriculture-affiliated foundation established in 2014 in Hsinchu, runs an Industry Development Center that incubates and commercializes agri-tech ventures — guiding roughly 60 agricultural firms a year through tech diffusion, incubation advisory and industrialization, chiefly as a non-equity service provider.
summary.local: 農業科技研究院（農科院）為農業部所屬、2014 年成立於新竹的財團法人，其產業發展中心負責農業科技產業化與事業化育成，每年輔導約 60 家農業廠商，下設技術擴散、育成輔導與產業加值三組，主要以非股權的服務輔導為主。

Incubates agri-tech startups across breeding biotech, livestock-product processing, aquaculture, forestry, crop development, biotech products and agricultural machinery.

aka: 台灣國際農業開發股份有限公司
Taiwan Agriculture International Development Co., Ltd.

aum.raw: paid-in capital NT$240M; authorized NT$1 billion

strategy.thesis: A government-initiated, semi-public agricultural trading and development company (the 'agriculture national team') set up under Council of Agriculture guidance, capitalized by Taiwan Fertilizer, Mega Bank, TAITRA, the ICDF and others. Builds plan-based, market-oriented export production chains, cold-chain logistics and overseas agricultural investment, aligned with Taiwan's New Southbound agricultural cooperation policy.

application.how_to_apply: B2B agricultural trade / cooperation partner, not an open startup-application program.

summary.en: A semi-public agricultural trading and development company established December 2016 under Council of Agriculture guidance (the 'agriculture national team'), with NT$240M paid-in capital (NT$1B authorized) funded by Taiwan Fertilizer, Mega Bank, TAITRA and the ICDF. Focuses on export production chains, cold-chain logistics and overseas agricultural investment under the New Southbound policy.
summary.local: 農委會輔導、2016 年 12 月成立的公辦民營農業貿易與開發公司（農業國家隊），實收資本額新台幣 2.4 億元、額定資本額 10 億元，由台肥、兆豐銀行、外貿協會、國合會等出資，聚焦外銷產銷體系、冷鏈物流與配合新南向政策的海外農業投資。
